title: Work, Energy & Power
notes: **Work** W = F·s = F s cos θ. Work done by a variable force = area under the F–s graph.
**Kinetic energy** KE = ½mv². **Work–energy theorem:** net work done = change in kinetic energy.
**Potential energy:** gravitational PE = mgh; elastic PE = ½kx². For conservative forces, total mechanical energy (KE + PE) is conserved.
**Power** P = W/t = F·v, SI unit watt (1 W = 1 J s⁻¹). Energy units: 1 kWh = 3.6 × 10⁶ J.
